scientific_scope: Mn Me/tBu 配体环境对候选活性形式、两半反应和固定构型/镜像群体立体后果的影响。

required_numerical_evidence.description: Me/tBu 两系列候选形成/转化及醇结合稳定化的配平 Gibbs 能量差。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed balanced Gibbs-energy differences for candidate formation/conversion and alcohol-binding stabilization in both Me and tBu series.

required_numerical_evidence.description: Me/tBu 系列 NN/NNS 氧化的匹配 Gibbs 活化量和环境间差值。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed matched Gibbs activation energies and coordination-environment differences for NN/NNS alcohol oxidation in the Me/tBu series.

required_numerical_evidence.description: Me/tBu 系列 NN/NNS 还原的匹配 Gibbs 活化量和环境间差值，明确供氢态/构型。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed matched Gibbs activation energies and coordination-environment differences for NN/NNS ketone reduction in the Me/tBu series, defining donor states and configurations.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 计入相应醇结合/静息态后的两半反应有效活化量及差值。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed effective activation energies and their difference for the two half-reactions after the relevant alcohol-bound/resting-state references are included.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 每个明确研究构型的两面还原活化量及 S/R 差值；镜像/群体推论复用这些实际数值和构型映射，不要求另算完整镜像网络。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed face-specific reduction activation energies and S/R differences for each explicitly investigated configuration. Apply these values and mappings to mirror/ensemble reasoning; no additional complete mirror-pathway calculation is required.

final_outcomes.description: 配体环境影响候选态形成和稳定
NN/NNS 环境对醇氧化的影响
NN/NNS 环境对酮还原的影响
静息态修正后的氧化控制
固定催化剂构型的微观立体偏好
镜像群体抵消与宏观选择性界限

verification_support: 正文 Figs.2/4–6/8、SI DOCX Tables S2/S3；历史验证支持配平候选平衡、两半反应及固定构型竞争。主文/打印热项/重构热项有差异，部分连接为有效 IRC 前缀或模式位移。
boundaries: 含硫配体但 S 臂不配位的 NN 三羰基候选，不等于无硫 HL_0 实验对照。
不强制 Me/tBu 内部细排序、不强制跨家族所有 R 通道排序或作者绝对值。
固定构型的微观偏好不能直接变为 achiral 镜像等布居群体的宏观 ee。
候选局部平衡不等于完整溶液物种分布。
题给三羰基前驱体不等于所有活性中间体固定为三羰基；不强制NNS+2CO，但NN/NNS两半反应比较在当前公开任务中已明示，不删除。旧冻结输入不由本次修改追溯覆盖。
source_locator: Main text p3–9 Fig.1–8; energy/coordinate tables in the SI DOCX
whole_case_success: All required_for_success outcomes must pass for whole-case success; each supported independent outcome retains its weighted points if other outcomes fail.
